column1: # Top-level domains of company websites (curated 2026-11-10). No source counts company websites by
# TLD: these are estimates guided by the registries' published name counts (DENIC, AFNIC, Nominet,
# SIDN, CNNIC, JPRS, Registro.br, auDA, CIRA, NIXI, ZACR; rounded figures in the notes, as known in
# 2025) set against Verisign's .com total, and rounded. To confirm in Milestone 3's research.
# tlds: suffix:share; "cc" is the country's own ccTLD (country-generator), a suffix with a dot
# inside is a second-level domain the registry reserves for companies. Countries without a row take
# the default of their region (prepare_tables.py, REGION_TLDS).

column3: DENIC: 17.8M .de names, the most of any ccTLD after .cn
.ru holds about 5M names; .рф (0.7M) is left out, since domains are built in Latin letters
JPRS: .co.jp is one per registered company
CNNIC: 20M .cn names; .中国 is left out, since domains are built in Latin letters
